en: Vintage illustrated postcard framed by a stylized stone arch and crenellated wall. At the top are two circular crests: one with a silver lion on a green background, the other with red, black, and yellow fields, a rising sun, and plants, encircled by German text. Below, in the arch opening, is a monochrome view of a grand historicist building with a central dome and two corner towers, labeled 'Rathaus'. A square with market stalls, umbrellas, pedestrians, and a tram is in front of the building. At the bottom, the word 'GRAZ' is printed.
